theorem lg_target {b x : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x => Real.exp (-(b * x))) (Set.Ioc 0 x) MeasureTheory.volume := by
  have h_cont : Continuous (fun x => Real.exp (-(b * x))) := by
    refine Continuous.comp _ _
    · exact Continuous.neg
    · exact Continuous.mul_left b
  have h_measurable : MeasurableSet (Set.Ioc 0 x) := by
    rw [MeasurableSet.def]
    exact is_open_Ioc.measurable
  have h_integrable : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x => Real.exp (-(b * x))) (Set.Ioc 0 x) MeasureTheory.volume :=
    by
    have h3 : ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.exp (-(b * x))) (Set.Ioc 0 x) := by
      rw [ContinuousOn.def]
      exact h_cont
    exact MeasureTheory.integrable_on_continuous_on h3 h_measurable
  exact h_integrable
